name: box-plot
purpose: Accessible SVG box plot for comparing distributions per category: boxes from the lower to the upper quartile with a median line, whiskers, and outlier dots. Each datum is precomputed statistics or raw values (type-7 quantiles, Tukey whiskers at 1.5 IQR by default, or min/max). Several series are grouped side by side with a toggleable legend; each box is one keyboard-reachable mark whose name reads the five-number summary and the outlier count, and a data table lists every statistic and the outlier values.
whenToUse: Comparing the spread, skew, and outliers of a measure across categories (for example latency per region).
Summarizing many raw values per category when individual values do not matter.
whenNotToUse: Few values per category: show them directly (Scatter Chart) instead of quartiles.
Audiences unfamiliar with quartiles: a Bar Chart of medians or a Histogram may read faster.
The shape of one distribution in detail (bimodal data): use Histogram.
responsive: Width follows the container (ResizeObserver); height is the height option. Categories share the width in bands; boxes of several series split each band. Category labels are truncated or thinned to fit. Reflows at 320 CSS px.
rtl: direction rtl mirrors the category axis (first category on the right) and the order of series within a category, puts the value axis on the right, and swaps ArrowLeft/ArrowRight.
theme: Boxes use color-chart-1..8 by palette slot: a translucent fill with a solid outline, whiskers in the series color, the median line in color-text, outlier dots filled with color-surface and outlined in the series color. Gridlines color-chart-grid, axes color-chart-axis, labels color-text-muted. Forced colors use CanvasText, Canvas, and Highlight.
security: All text (title, description, labels, values, tooltip, table) is set with textContent; SVG is built with createElementNS. Colors are CSS classes; the height and the tooltip position are written through the CSSOM (style.setProperty). No innerHTML, no style attributes, no inline handlers: works under style-src without unsafe-inline and require-trusted-types-for.
dataHandling: Renders the data it is given; raw values are summarized in memory on each render and never stored elsewhere. No persistence, network access, or telemetry. Values are not logged; validation errors name the option, never its value.

budgets.metric: BoxPlot.create, 4 series x 50 categories from raw values (100 values each), including the first render
budgets.budget: < 80 ms in headless Chromium (e2e performance test)

performance.testedScale: Up to about 200 boxes (each box is one focusable node plus whiskers, a median line, an optional texture overlay, and one dot per outlier). Raw values are sorted per box on every render; for very large samples pass precomputed statistics (boxStats) instead.

limitations: Every series needs exactly one datum per category.
whiskers applies to raw values only; precomputed statistics are drawn as given.
Outliers are decorative dots; their values are listed in the data table and counted in the box name.
A fixed valueAxis domain clamps boxes, whiskers, and outliers to its edges; valueAxis.includeZero is accepted but has no effect.
unsupported: Horizontal box plots, notched boxes, violin plots, and mean markers.
antiPatterns: Box plots of a handful of values per category (quartiles of three values mislead).
More than about 8 series per category.
Relying on color alone by turning patterns off for several series.
